item.title: Patchwork v0.7.1-beta
item.description: You can now install Patchwork with only Node.js and git using the new Easy mode default. You can now manage PostgreSQL, MinIO, and the app together via `npm run start`, `npm run stop`, and `npm run status`.

item.title: Patchwork v0.7.0-beta
item.description: You can now run Patchwork natively on Windows and Linux with multi-team Kanban boards, Calendar view, and real-time sync. You can now use the Spotlight command bar (`Ctrl+K` / `Cmd+K`) with slash commands, inline ghost hints, and scoped full-text search. You can now browse official documentation directly inside the app at `/documentation`.
